data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: flowsurface
edge_embedded.summary: Flowsurface 是一款专为加密货币市场设计的原生桌面图表平台，解决了实时订单簿和逐笔数据可视化对性能与可靠性的需求。该项目采用 Rust 语言和 Iced GUI 框架开发，通过系统级编程优势高效处理高频数据流，同时保持界面响应流畅。其架构展示了如何利用 Rust 的内存安全与并发特性构建稳定的金融应用，避免了传统 Web 工具在实时数据处理中的延迟问题。开发者可借此平台深入分析市场微观结构，扩展图表功能，或学习 Rust 在金融科技领域的实践应用。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Flowsurface is a native desktop charting platform specifically designed for cryptocurrency markets, addressing the need for reliable, high-performance visualization of real-time orderbook and tick data. Built with Rust and the Iced GUI framework, it leverages systems programming strengths to handle high-frequency data streams efficiently while maintaining responsive user interfaces. Developers can use it to analyze market microstructure, extend its charting capabilities, or study how Rust enables robust financial applications beyond web-based tools.

agents_workflows.name: dify
agents_workflows.summary: Dify 是一个开源平台，旨在简化 AI 智能体和流程的构建，无需大量编码即可应对多模型协同的复杂性。它通过可视化、低代码界面将推理、工具调用和记忆等 AI 能力串联起来，实现模块化、可复用的智能体设计。开发者能快速原型化多步骤 AI 流程，例如构建可获取数据并自主决策的客服机器人，并直接部署到生产环境，便于实际应用和扩展实验。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Dify is an open-source platform that simplifies building AI agents and workflows without extensive coding, addressing the complexity of orchestrating multiple AI models. It uses a visual, low-code interface to chain together different AI capabilities like reasoning, tool use, and memory, enabling modular and reusable agent designs. Developers can quickly prototype multi-step AI processes—such as customer support bots that fetch data and make decisions—then deploy them directly to production environments for real-world use.

deployment_serving.name: MediaCrawler
deployment_serving.summary: MediaCrawler 是一个专注于中文社交媒体平台的 Python 爬虫工具，它能高效地从小红书、抖音、B站等网站抓取笔记、视频和评论数据，解决了手动收集网络内容费时费力的问题。其技术亮点在于采用模块化设计来应对不同平台的反爬机制，开发者可以灵活调整策略以稳定获取数据。实践上，用户可通过命令行快速启动数据采集，或将其 API 集成到自己的分析流程中，用于市场调研、舆情分析或学术研究，为理解在线社区动态提供可靠的数据基础。
deployment_serving.summary_en: MediaCrawler is a Python-based web scraping tool that simplifies data collection from major Chinese social media platforms like Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Bilibili, addressing the challenge of accessing structured content for analysis. Its technical strength lies in handling platform-specific anti-scraping measures through modular design, allowing targeted adaptation. Users can deploy it via command-line interfaces or integrate its APIs into custom pipelines for tasks like sentiment analysis, trend monitoring, or academic research on digital behavior.

framework_core.name: dify
framework_core.summary: Dify 是一个开源平台，旨在简化 AI 智能体和流程的构建，无需大量编码即可应对多模型协同的复杂性。它通过可视化、低代码界面将推理、工具调用和记忆等 AI 能力串联起来，实现模块化、可复用的智能体设计。开发者能快速原型化多步骤 AI 流程，例如构建可获取数据并自主决策的客服机器人，并直接部署到生产环境，便于实际应用和扩展实验。
framework_core.summary_en: Dify is an open-source platform that simplifies building AI agents and workflows without extensive coding, addressing the complexity of orchestrating multiple AI models. It uses a visual, low-code interface to chain together different AI capabilities like reasoning, tool use, and memory, enabling modular and reusable agent designs. Developers can quickly prototype multi-step AI processes—such as customer support bots that fetch data and make decisions—then deploy them directly to production environments for real-world use.

framework_core.name: flowsurface
framework_core.summary: Flowsurface 是一款专为加密货币市场设计的原生桌面图表平台，解决了实时订单簿和逐笔数据可视化对性能与可靠性的需求。该项目采用 Rust 语言和 Iced GUI 框架开发，通过系统级编程优势高效处理高频数据流，同时保持界面响应流畅。其架构展示了如何利用 Rust 的内存安全与并发特性构建稳定的金融应用，避免了传统 Web 工具在实时数据处理中的延迟问题。开发者可借此平台深入分析市场微观结构，扩展图表功能，或学习 Rust 在金融科技领域的实践应用。
framework_core.summary_en: Flowsurface is a native desktop charting platform specifically designed for cryptocurrency markets, addressing the need for reliable, high-performance visualization of real-time orderbook and tick data. Built with Rust and the Iced GUI framework, it leverages systems programming strengths to handle high-frequency data streams efficiently while maintaining responsive user interfaces. Developers can use it to analyze market microstructure, extend its charting capabilities, or study how Rust enables robust financial applications beyond web-based tools.
